mappingNote.en: Anger-screen flag only — severity instruments (STAXI-CA / CAS) quantify anger dimensions and require clinical confirmation before any diagnostic use.
mappingNote.hi: केवल क्रोध-स्क्रीन धनात्मक — तीव्रता-पैमाने (STAXI-CA / CAS) क्रोध-आयाम मापते हैं; रोग-निर्णय हेतु नैदानिक पुष्टि आवश्यक।

description.en: Recurrent behavioural outbursts representing impulsive aggressive episodes; anger instruments quantify severity but cannot diagnose.
description.hi: Recurrent behavioural outbursts representing impulsive aggressive episodes; anger instruments quantify severity but cannot diagnose.
